up: Return activity rows for the target CHEMBL1951 (Amine oxidase [flavin-containing] A). Include only rows where the target type is 'SINGLE PROTEIN', the target taxonomy ID (tax_id) is 9606 (Homo sapiens), the standard type is 'IC50', the standard relation is '=' (exact value), and a pChEMBL value exists. Return the first 1000 rows ordered by molecule ChEMBL ID and then assay ChEMBL ID. Output the following columns: assay ChEMBL ID, target type, target tax_id, canonical SMILES, molecule ChEMBL ID, standard type, and pChEMBL value.
sql:
SELECT
  ass.chembl_id AS assay_chembl_id,
  td.target_type,
  td.tax_id,
  cs.canonical_smiles,
  md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id,
  act.standard_type,
  act.pchembl_value
FROM activities act
JOIN assays ass ON act.assay_id = ass.assay_id
JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON act.molregno = md.molregno
JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno
WHERE
  td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1951'
  AND td.target_type = 'SINGLE PROTEIN'
  AND td.tax_id = 9606
  AND act.standard_type = 'IC50'
  AND act.standard_relation = '='
  AND act.pchembl_value IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY md.chembl_id, ass.chembl_id
LIMIT 1000;
